_readme: Sourced public statements, keyed by bioguide id (if the person has served in Congress) or FEC candidate id. Each entry may have 'iran' and/or 'israel': { quotes:[{text, source, url, date}] } (shown only when the candidate has no voting record). RULES: quote text must be verbatim from the linked source (keep it short; use an ellipsis rather than paraphrase); date is when it was SAID or published; max 3 per topic; never attribute a quote to a speaker unless the source does. Optional 'stance'/'summary' fields are only used when we have no votes. Optional 'flag' (short text) marks a documented change of position. Optional 'badge': {tier: full|partial|mixed|against, label} sets the collapsed label by hand when a position can't be read from phrases (used for documented changes of position).
